title: Lease financials and lifecycle
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-5 met. AC-3 is now met through the WFL-05 task inbox: its gateway test loads the expiring LSE-03 projection as a LEASE_EXPIRY task with the lease route.

dataModel.decision: The LeaseAcquisition financial and lifecycle partials return hard-coded projections and there was no persistence for terms, obligations, payments or lifecycle events. The plan's own contract (OgLeaseTerms, NRI arithmetic) and AC-4/AC-5 were implemented as four LeaseAcquisition-owned tables, registered in the module.
tables: LEASE_TERM (TERM_ID key, LEASE_ID, TERM_TYPE, EFFECTIVE_DATE, EXPIRY_DATE, BONUS_AMOUNT, BONUS_CURRENCY, ROYALTY_RATE, NET_REVENUE_INTEREST, OVERRIDING_ROYALTY, BURDENS_TEXT, RATIONALE, ACTOR, RECORDED_AT) - append-only; a renewal appends and deactivates, never deletes
LEASE_OBLIGATION (OBLIGATION_ID key, LEASE_ID, OBLIGATION_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, DUE_DATE, MINIMUM_SPEND, CURRENCY, ACTOR, RECORDED_AT) - rental / minimum-spend commitments; overdue is computed
LEASE_PAYMENT (PAYMENT_ID key, LEASE_ID, OBLIGATION_ID, PAID_AT, AMOUNT, CURRENCY, KIND, REFERENCE, ACTOR, RECORDED_AT)
LEASE_LIFECYCLE (EVENT_ID key, LEASE_ID, EVENT, EFFECTIVE_DATE, RATIONALE, ACTOR, RECORDED_AT) - append-only RENEWED / RELINQUISHED / EXPIRED events
dataModel.registration: Beep.OilandGas.LeaseAcquisition/Modules/LeaseAcquisitionModule.cs registers the four types; the module summary now reports 355 entity types.

implementation.service: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Lease/OgLeaseFinancials.cs (OgLeaseBurden, OgLeaseTerms, OgLeaseNri, OgLeaseObligation, OgLeasePayment, OgLeaseLifecycleEntry, OgLeaseFinancialSummary, OgLeaseExpiryBucket, OgLeaseFinancialDetail, OgLeaseExpiryTask, OgLeaseRenewal, IOgLeaseFinancials, OgLeaseFinancialService)
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/LeaseFinancialsPageView.cs (route 'leasefinancials': financial grid, terms card, obligations, payments, term history, lifecycle; edit terms, record obligation/payment, renew, relinquish, expire, retry)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgLeaseFinancials), OgApplication.LeaseFinancials, catalog 'leasefinancials' (OgModuleKeys.Lease), OgPageFactory, en + ar labels
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/LeaseFinancialTests.cs (11, no database) + LeaseFinancialGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.database: SQLite with LEASE_ACQUISITION plus LEASE_TERM, LEASE_OBLIGATION, LEASE_PAYMENT and LEASE_LIFECYCLE, seeded in LeaseFinancialGatewayTests
integration.register: one lease for F-1 expiring 2026-07-15 (44 days from 2026-06-01, Expiring); the bucket '31-60 days' holds it; one obligation is overdue
integration.detail: royalty 0.125, NRI 0.775, ORR 0.05, one burden 'landowner 5%', two obligations (O-1 overdue 31 days), one payment, one term
integration.ac1_refused: SaveTerms with a supplied NRI of 0.9 is refused with lease-financial-nri-unrepresentable; no term is written
integration.ac2_precision: the royalty text is the fraction at eight places (0.12500000 / 12.5%); a rate with more than eight places or outside [0,1] is refused by OgLeaseNri
integration.ac4_renewal: SaveTerms appends an AMENDED term and deactivates the original; Renew appends a RENEWAL term, leaves both older terms in the table, updates LEASE_ACQUISITION.LEASE_EXPIRATION to 2027-07-15 and appends RENEWED to LEASE_LIFECYCLE
integration.ac5_overdue: O-1 (due 2026-05-01) is overdue 31 days at 2026-06-01; a payment that references O-1 makes it paid and the re-read detail reports 0 overdue. O-2 (due 2026-07-01) is not overdue
integration.ac3_projection: ExpiringTasksAsync(asOf) returns L-1 with bucket '31-60 days' and route 'leasefinancials'; the task inbox itself is WFL-05 and is not built
integration.lost_ack: a SQLite trigger made the LEASE_TERM insert fail; the renewal was refused and retained (Pending with the same rationale), no term was added; after the trigger was dropped, RetryAsync appended the term and the acquisition row expired 2028-07-15
integration.lifecycle: RelinquishAsync appends RELINQUISHED and leaves the four terms intact

gates.AC-1 NRI arithmetic refuses an unreprese: pass - OgLeaseNri derives NRI = 1 - royalty - ORR - burdens, refuses a total above gross for a normal lease, refuses a supplied NRI that differs from the derivation by more than 1e-8, and lets only NET_PROFIT types record it directly. The SQLite test proves the refusal and that nothing was written.
gates.AC-2 Royalty rate is stored as a fractio: pass - the rate is a decimal fraction validated to at most 8 places and rendered as '0.12500000' / '12.5%'; the test covers the precision and range refusals.
gates.AC-3 Expiring leases appear in the task: pass - OgLeaseFinancialService.ExpiringTasksAsync produces the 30/60/90 projection and the WFL-05 inbox merges it as a LEASE_EXPIRY task with route leasefinancials; TaskInboxGatewayTests proves the lease L-1 appears in the inbox with a present source. The inbox is WFL-05 and is now built (evidence STG-14-WFL-05).
gates.AC-4 Renewal creates a new term and reta: pass - SaveTerms and Renew append a LEASE_TERM and deactivate the previous one; the SQLite test sees every earlier expiry still present (the 2026-07-15 terms remain after the 2027 and 2028 renewals) and the acquisition row follows the active term.
gates.AC-5 Overdue obligations are computed fr: pass - overdue = due date before asOf and no payment references the obligation; the test proves 31 days overdue, the clearing payment, and that the future O-2 is not overdue. No status column is written.

limits: AC-3 is consumed by the WFL-05 task inbox (route tasks); the inbox is a separate feature and its evidence records the merge. The persona landing map is unchanged (FND-07 policy).

The rental schedule is the set of obligations of type RENTAL; there is no separate rental table, because AC-5 treats obligations and rentals the same way (a due date, an amount and a computed overdue state).
The screen does not post accounting journals: the boundary with ACC-07 is respected by reading and writing lease financials only, and LeaseAccountingService is not called.
A write result is computed at today's date (the page always passes today); a caller that needs a historical view re-reads LoadDetailAsync with its own asOf, as the gateway test does.
The new tables need the LEASE_ACQUISITION module applied again on an existing database to be created.
Overriding royalty and burdens live on LEASE_TERM, not on LEASE_ACQUISITION (the acquisition row has no columns for them); an opportunity with no term shows no ORR/burdens.
